slices.focus: Hard conversation leads to protecting one day monthly for the couple.
slices.summary: After months of canceled dinners and provisional evenings, Jae-hyun and Min-seo have an honest conversation during a short Tongyeong trip. They agree to protect one fully planned day together each month, put on the calendar first and defended against work spillover and family errands. Jae-hyun commits to a polite but firm boundary line with family: 'I can't do that that day, we already have plans.'
open_loops: First protected day execution and follow-through
Maintaining the habit during peak seasons
decisions: He and his wife agreed to protect one fully planned day together each month despite his rotating dispatch shifts.
